test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.**

Sulochana, whose ______ I had so admired during the festival, seemed a different person.
solution: The correct answer is **"grace."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The sentence is talking about Sulochana's quality that the speaker had admired during the festival. • **Grace** means the ability to move in a smooth and controlled way. (व्यवस्थित तथा अनुशासित चेष्‍टा-क्षमता; लालित्‍य) • **Example**: *Joanna has natural **grace**__ and elegance.* • The word that fits the blank should be a positive quality that can change someone's impression. • Out of the given options,** "grace"** is the most appropriate word that can fit the context. • The correct answer is Option 3. **Correct sentence**: *Sulochana, whose __**grace**__ I had so admired during the festival, seemed a different person.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1 (polish)** means smoothness or refinement, but it doesn't necessarily convey a change in personality. (जूते आदि को चमकाने की क्रीम, द्रव वस्‍तु; पॉलिश) • **Option 2 (crudeness)** means roughness or lack of manners, which is the opposite of what the sentence is implying. (खुरदरापन या शिष्टाचार की कमी, जो वाक्य के अर्थ के विपरीत है) • **Option 4 (shadow)** means a dark shape on a surface that is caused by something being between the light and that surface. (परछाई (प्रकाश और सतह के बीच में किसी के आने से सतह पर बनी उसकी धुँधली आकृति), साया) 1c3:Ta75, The correct answer is **"Honestly."**
